targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(bucket, '1h') AS time, outcome AS metric, sum(n)::float AS value FROM caib.events_5m WHERE module = 'aws_cloudtrail' AND $__timeFilter(bucket) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT actor, sum(n) AS events, sum(failures) AS failures FROM caib.actors_1h WHERE module = 'aws_cloudtrail' AND bucket > now() - interval '24 hours' AND actor IS NOT NULL GROUP BY actor ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT action, sum(n) AS events FROM caib.events_5m WHERE module = 'aws_cloudtrail' AND bucket > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY action ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT event_time, actor, action, attrs->>'error_code' AS error_code, host(src_ip) AS src_ip FROM caib.events WHERE module = 'aws_cloudtrail' AND outcome = 'failure' AND $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT attrs->>'event_source' AS event_source, count(*) AS events FROM caib.events WHERE module = 'aws_cloudtrail' AND event_time > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT coalesce(attrs->>'mfa', 'unknown') AS mfa, count(*) AS logins FROM caib.events WHERE module = 'aws_cloudtrail' AND action = 'ConsoleLogin' AND event_time > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY logins DESC
